candidate_universe: The v0.4.0 wide solid-tumour candidate universe, updated only for identifier retirements and additions documented before the 2026-08-04 cutoff.

GSE115978.response_policy: use supplied response only when explicitly present

GSE120575.response_policy: excluded from contextual encoder input because counts are TPM

endpoint: First public ClinicalTrials.gov Phase I-or-later entry after 2026-08-04 for a single-direct-human-target therapeutic intervention in a prespecified solid-tumour indication, excluding target-indication pairs with a qualifying entry on or before the cutoff.
forbidden_actions: Reuse v0.4.0 holdout labels as an independent v0.5 evaluation.
Choose the snapshot date after inspecting model scores or metrics.
Change sampling, context definitions, PCA budget or alpha grid after future labels open.
Promote a secondary method to confirmatory status after results are known.
Treat GSE120575 TPM as raw-count input to Geneformer or scGPT.
Collapse discordant GSE179994 lesions to a patient-level response label.
known_limitations: Geneformer and scGPT pretraining-accession overlap remains unresolved.
Only melanoma and NSCLC provide real raw-count cellular contexts.
The clinical endpoint is operational and sparse; absence of entry is not biological failure.
The final v0.5 result cannot exist until a scheduled future snapshot passes the power gate.

methods.pooling: token-to-gene mean within sample-context, then equal-weight sample mean
methods.representation: Geneformer V1-10M final token hidden states from real cells
shape-matched random Geneformer token hidden states

methods.pooling: token-to-gene mean within sample-context, then equal-weight sample mean
methods.representation: scGPT whole-human final gene-token hidden states from real cells
shape-matched random scGPT gene-token hidden states

outcome_window_end_rule: Use the first scheduled snapshot satisfying the power gate, without inspecting any method scores or performance; otherwise stop at the maximum snapshot date and abstain.

primary_contrast.decision_rule: SUPPORTED only when the paired gene-bootstrap 95% interval for delta AUPRC is strictly above zero; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED or DETECTABLE_LOSS.

sampling.selection: lowest_sha256(cell_id + seed) within each sample-context stratum

snapshot_schedule.selection_rule: Evaluate snapshots in chronological order and select the first that passes the label-only power gate. Model scores remain inaccessible during gate assessment.
